components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loudest element per screen — gold fill, brand glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 26px; background: var(--deg-gold, #F7BA17); color: var(--deg-ink-on-gold, #261A00); box-shadow: 0 10px 12px rgba(247,186,23,.25); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 16px rgba(247,186,23,.32); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--deg-cream,#FFF7EA), 0 0 0 4px var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Secondary action fill — 'Store info', the cart drawer's 'Apply' promo button.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 26px; background: var(--deg-ink-deep, #130D00); color: #FBF3E3; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--deg-cream,#FFF7EA), 0 0 0 4px var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); }

components.name: Chip / Segmented Toggle
components.description: The one single-select pill control — pickup/delivery, store picker, tip percentage.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: var(--deg-cream-cool, #F5F0E8); padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip { background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: var(--deg-ink-body, #140F0A); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip--active { background: var(--deg-gold, #F7BA17); color: var(--deg-ink-on-gold, #261A00); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--deg-cream,#FFF7EA), 0 0 0 4px var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); }

components.name: Shop Card
components.description: The one unified card component reused across every menu category.
components.html: 2 Pack Deviled Egg$4.99
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; background: var(--deg-white,#fff); border: 1px solid var(--deg-border-card,#F3F3F3); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 3px 9px -1px rgba(17,24,39,.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(17,24,39,.04); overflow: hidden; min-height: 100px; } .ds-card-body { flex-grow: 1; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; color: var(--deg-ink-heading,#402D00); } .ds-card-meta { padding-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-price { font-weight: 600; color: var(--deg-ink-heading,#402D00); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Every text field in the product shares this one rule.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search McKinney, Tx Menu">
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--deg-ink-body,#140F0A); border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--deg-border-input,#D9D1BF); padding: 14px 22px; background: var(--deg-white,#fff); width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--deg-ink-muted,#635E57); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--deg-cream,#FFF7EA), 0 0 0 4px var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: White bar, hairline bottom border, bold uppercase 13px links, dark circular cart button with red count badge.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: var(--deg-white,#fff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--deg-border-card,#F3F3F3); padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 21px; color: var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); } .ds-nav-links { flex-grow: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 10px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--deg-ink-body,#140F0A); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-cart { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: var(--deg-ink-deep,#130D00); color: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-cart::after { content: attr(class); }

components.name: Sidebar Category Item
components.description: The menu-category drawer in the sidebar — active state gets a bronze left accent and a golden-wash fill.
components.css: .ds-drawer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 260px; } .ds-drawer-item { text-align: left; background: transparent; border: none; border-left: 4px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 12px 14px 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 24px; color: var(--deg-ink-muted,#635E57); cursor: pointer; } .ds-drawer-item--active { background: var(--deg-gold-tint,#FFDEA0); border-left-color: var(--deg-border-primary,#88754F); color: var(--deg-ink-heading,#402D00); }

narrative.overview:
One earned, confident gold sits against warm cream and near-black ink — everything else in the system stays quiet on purpose, so the gold reads as quality rather than decoration. The palette, radius language, and shadow system all reinforce the same restraint: a single saturated accent, a near-universal pill/rounded corner, and a warm gold glow that appears exclusively on primary calls to action. Nothing competes with the yolk.

Typography carries the same discipline in two voices: Nunito at extrabold/bold weight is reserved for headings and prices only, never body copy; Plus Jakarta Sans handles everything else, from paragraph text down to the all-caps 13px navigation labels. The system was audited from the live deviledeggco.com site and cross-checked against the DECo_Order_260920 Figma file — it is a real, evidenced brand system, not an invented one.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated accent (#F7BA17), rare and rule-bound to primary actions
Warm cream surfaces (#FFF7EA) as the dominant background, never stark white
Near-universal pill (999px) or soft (8–16px) corner radius; nothing sharp
Two-voice type system: Nunito extrabold/bold for headings & prices, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else
Low-contrast, tonal card shadows; the only colored shadow is the gold CTA glow

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Golden Yolk is the only saturated color anywhere in the system. It appears on primary buttons, active toggle/chip states, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Nunito extrabold/bold is reserved for headings and prices — never body copy, never buttons, never labels. Plus Jakarta Sans carries every other voice.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: The one colored shadow in the system is bound to primary CTAs and nothing else. A card, a chip, a hover state — none of them borrow the gold glow.

rules.name: The No-Sharp-Corner Rule
rules.body: Every rectangle in the system carries a radius from the scale. A border-radius: 0 anywhere is a bug, not a style.

dos: Do keep Golden Yolk to primary CTAs and active-selection states only — one per screen is the target.
Do use Nunito extrabold/bold exclusively for headings and prices; everything else is Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do make the gap between content groups larger than the gap within a group.
Do reuse an existing radius/shadow/spacing token before introducing a new value.
Do prefer a project token over a raw Figma literal when a source color is unbound to a variable.
donts: Don't add a second saturated color.
Don't use a colored shadow anywhere except the primary-CTA brand glow.
Don't introduce a sharp (0px) corner anywhere.
Don't letter-space the nav labels or add extra gap between them.
